NukeApp-OSS bundles the LSPatch patching engine and its loader resources.

LSPatch: https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch
Version: v1.2 / build 487
Source: https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch/tree/0dc50f42503711b14f5e2bb217c2bdd6321ce5be
Official release: https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch/releases/tag/v1.2
Original JAR: lspatch-v1.2-487-release.jar
Original SHA-256: d238fdc414d121b7fa454d8b4ccf420df3a8c97d563761861ff92bd9c5da2165

LSPatch originates from LSPosed/LSPatch and Xpatch. Its loader and framework
derive from LSPosed and Vector, with contributions by their respective authors.
LSPatch and Vector are distributed under GPL-3.0; the accompanying GPL-3.0.txt
contains the license text. Refer to the fixed sources for individual notices.
Vector source: https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector/tree/e00c5c5038bbcc14e0b382ab893301d6993e6989
Original project: https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPatch

NukeApp-OSS does not modify third-party class or payload bytes. During build
preparation it removes the upstream public test keystores assets/keystore and
assets/new_keystore, Java multi-release/module metadata and any stale JAR
signature metadata, and normalizes the archive metadata. The six loader payloads
are copied byte-for-byte into generated Android assets and are excluded from the
patcher class JAR, because R8 cannot consume classes and DEX in one input JAR.
Loader resource paths in the application remain unchanged. A patched APK is signed with a device-local key, not an
upstream bundled test key. The upstream binaries are cached only under build/;
the exact release and payload hashes are recorded in apps/patcher/lspatch.lock.json.

The original JAR also contains third-party dependencies and their notices.
The prepared engine preserves those resources, including LICENSE,
META-INF/LICENSE, Maven metadata and Bouncy Castle resource files.

Included components and source/license locations:
- Modified Android apkzlib: Apache-2.0; fixed LSPatch source under apkzlib/.
- Android apksig 8.0.2: Apache-2.0; https://android.googlesource.com/platform/tools/apksig/
- Manifest/AXML editing: LSPatch's fixed patch/ and Vector's fixed axml/ sources.
- Guava 32.0.1-jre and failureaccess: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/google/guava
- Gson 2.13.1: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/google/gson
- Commons IO 2.20.0: Apache-2.0; https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-io/
- JCommander 1.82: Apache-2.0; https://github.com/cbeust/jcommander
- JSR-305, Error Prone and J2ObjC annotations retain their upstream license metadata.
- Bouncy Castle bcprov/bcpkix 1.70: MIT; https://www.bouncycastle.org/licence.html
